# Every accepted purity marker, in the comment form its own ecosystem writes
# it in. All six make a function foldable; each folded value is a different
# string so the page can only carry it if that marker was read.
#
# @sngl-pure is ours and means deterministic. The rest were defined to mean
# side-effect-free, which is weaker — they are honored because a library in
# node_modules cannot be annotated by the person compiling it.
[!node] skip
env SNGL_CONSTEVAL_CACHE=$WORK/evalcache

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

grep 'folded-ours' out/index.html
grep 'folded-line' out/index.html
grep 'folded-rollup-at' out/index.html
grep 'folded-rollup-hash' out/index.html
grep 'folded-closure' out/index.html
grep 'folded-pure-at' out/index.html
grep 'folded-pure-hash' out/index.html

# Nothing was left for the browser to compute.
! grep 'marker-' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import lib "js://./lib"

component main {
    text(value=lib.ours())
    text(value=lib.lineComment())
    text(value=lib.rollupAt())
    text(value=lib.rollupHash())
    text(value=lib.closure())
    text(value=lib.pureAt())
    text(value=lib.pureHash())
}
-- lib/index.ts --
/** @sngl-pure */
export function ours(): string {
    return "folded-" + "ours";
}

// @sngl-pure
export function lineComment(): string {
    return "folded-" + "line";
}

/** @__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__ */
export function rollupAt(): string {
    return "folded-" + "rollup-at";
}

/*#__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__*/
export function rollupHash(): string {
    return "folded-" + "rollup-hash";
}

/** @nosideeffects */
export function closure(): string {
    return "folded-" + "closure";
}

/** @__PURE__ */
export function pureAt(): string {
    return "folded-" + "pure-at";
}

/*#__PURE__*/
export function pureHash(): string {
    return "folded-" + "pure-hash";
}
